name: Nearby Flights
description: Nearby Flights screensaver: a list and a scope of the aircraft overhead, from your own receiver or adsb.lol.
author: Mike Janofsky

settings.title: Home latitude
settings.description: Decimal degrees, e.g. 27.1234. Negative is south.

settings.title: Home longitude
settings.description: Decimal degrees, e.g. -82.1234. Negative is west.

settings.title: Radius limit
settings.description: Hard: never show aircraft beyond the radius. Soft: reach farther while the list has empty rows.

settings.title: Soft reach (nm)
settings.description: How far Soft may reach. Ignored when Radius limit is Hard.

settings.title: Units
settings.description: Aviation: nm, ft. Metric: km, m. Imperial: mi, ft.

settings.title: Clock format
settings.description: Use the device locale or choose a 12-hour or 24-hour clock. The device time zone is unchanged.

settings.title: Text size (%)
settings.description: Scales the type. Larger text elides long lines sooner, and four rows may not fit on a short screen.

settings.title: Featured aircraft hold (s)
settings.description: Longest the top band keeps one aircraft while others are in range. A clearly closer aircraft can still take it sooner.

settings.title: Rows
settings.description: List rows below the featured aircraft (the top band).

settings.title: Radar position (portrait only)
settings.description: Top: under the featured aircraft. Bottom: below the list.

settings.title: Show city names
settings.description: Show the route as city names (for example Chicago to Tampa) where they fit, instead of airport codes. Falls back to codes when the line is too long or the airport has no city. Beta (native) screensaver only.

settings.title: Hide general aviation
settings.description: Hides light aircraft, helicopters and bare-registration callsigns.

settings.title: Demo: quiet sky
settings.description: Always show the empty-sky screen, to preview it. Turn off for normal use.

settings.title: Primary source
settings.description: Local + adsb.lol asks both every refresh and merges them: a home antenna hears only part of the traffic.

settings.title: Local feed URL
settings.description: The readsb/tar1090 aircraft.json address, e.g. http://host:port/data/aircraft.json.

settings.title: Fallback source
settings.description: Used when the primary source is unavailable. adsb.lol data is ODbL; see the README.

settings.title: Refresh (s)
settings.description: Seconds between position updates.

settings.title: Show weather
settings.description: Show the current weather under the clock, from the Home Assistant weather entity chosen below. Beta (native) screensaver only.

settings.title: Weather entity
settings.description: A Home Assistant weather entity, such as weather.home. Shows in the same unit as the weather entity.

settings.title: Temperature
settings.description: Show the temperature in the weather line.

settings.title: Conditions
settings.description: How the conditions (Sunny, Rain) show in the weather line: a small icon, the word, both or neither.

settings.title: Wind
settings.description: Add the wind to the weather line, in the unit of the weather entity. It is the first thing dropped when the line is too long.
